neutral.EN: Careful. You are making me smile.
neutral.TL: Dahan-dahan. Napapangiti mo ako.

neutral.EN: You have a sweet way of making this ruined world bearable.
neutral.TL: May paraan ka para gawing magaan ang sirang mundong ito.

neutral.EN: I did not think romance still existed out here. Thanks.
neutral.TL: Hindi ko akalaing may puwang pa ang pag-ibig dito. Salamat.

neutral.EN: You always manage to soften my defenses.
neutral.TL: Lagi mong napapalambot ang mga pader sa puso ko.

neutral.EN: It is nice having someone look at me like that.
neutral.TL: Masarap sa pakiramdam na may tumitingin sa akin nang ganyan.

neutral.EN: You make my heart beat faster, and not from running.
neutral.TL: Pinapabilis mo ang tibok ng puso ko, at hindi dahil sa pagtakbo.

neutral.EN: I am not used to feeling this way anymore. But I like it.
neutral.TL: Hindi na ako sanay sa ganitong pakiramdam. Pero gusto ko.

neutral.EN: You make the dark days feel a little warmer.
neutral.TL: Pinapainit mo ang malamig at madilim na mga araw.

neutral.EN: Keep looking at me like that and see what happens.
neutral.TL: Tingnan mo pa ako nang ganyan at tingnan natin.

neutral.EN: I cherish moments like this with you.
neutral.TL: Iniingatan ko ang mga sandaling tulad nito kasama ka.

neutral.EN: You always know how to get my attention.
neutral.TL: Alam mo talaga kung paano kukunin ang pansin ko.

neutral.EN: My eyes are always finding you in a crowd anyway.
neutral.TL: Lagi naman kitang hinahanap ng paningin ko kahit saan.

neutral.EN: You have had my attention for a while now.
neutral.TL: Matagal mo nang nakuha ang atensyon ko.

neutral.EN: You do not even have to try. I am already looking.
neutral.TL: Hindi mo na kailangang magsikap. Nakatingin na ako sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: There is nobody else I would rather have standing by me.
neutral.TL: Wala nang ibang taong gugustuhin kong makatabi kundi ikaw.

neutral.EN: You have a hold on me, you know that right?
neutral.TL: May hawak ka sa puso ko, alam mo 'yon diba?

neutral.EN: Whenever you speak, I listen.
neutral.TL: Tuwing nagsasalita ka, nakikinig ako.

neutral.EN: You never have to fight for my attention.
neutral.TL: Hindi mo kailangang ipaglaban ang pansin ko.

neutral.EN: I am right here with you. Always.
neutral.TL: Narito lang ako kasama mo. Palagi.

neutral.EN: You have got me completely focused on you.
neutral.TL: Nasa sa 'yo na ang buong atensyon ko.

neutral.EN: That is a dangerous thing to say to me.
neutral.TL: Mapanganib na bagay ang sabihin 'yan sa akin.

neutral.EN: You make me want things I thought were gone forever.
neutral.TL: Pinapangarap mo sa akin ang mga bagay na akala ko'y nawala na.

neutral.EN: Caring about someone out here is terrifying. But worth it.
neutral.TL: Nakakatakot magmahal sa mundong ito. Pero sulit.

neutral.EN: Do not make promises this world will try to break.
neutral.TL: Huwag kang mangako ng mga bagay na sisirain lang ng mundong ito.

neutral.EN: If we fall for each other, there is no going back.
neutral.TL: Kapag nahulog tayo sa isa't isa, wala nang balikan.

neutral.EN: You are making me vulnerable, and that scares me a little.
neutral.TL: Pinaparamdam mo ang kahinaan ko, at medyo nakakatakot 'yon.

neutral.EN: Dangerous words. But I am not pulling away.
neutral.TL: Mapanganib na salita. Pero hindi ako lumalayo.

neutral.EN: You have no idea what that does to my resolve.
neutral.TL: Wala kang ideya kung paano niyan ginigiba ang tibay ng loob ko.

neutral.EN: If you keep talking like that, I might just hold onto you.
neutral.TL: Kung magpapatuloy ka sa ganyan, baka hindi na kita mabitawan.

neutral.EN: It is dangerous, yes. But I want to believe you.
neutral.TL: Mapanganib, oo. Pero gusto kitang paniwalaan.
